messages.text:
BL-877 — DEFECT — process-liveness detection scans /proc, which macOS does not have: both the sandbox sweep's keep-guard and the fixture reaper's orphan-kill are inert on the swarm's own host, and the three tests that would say so are red
What it solves: - Fourth occurrence of the same class in this area (BL-420 -> BL-459 ->
  BL-872 for temp-dir traps; BL-874 for GNU-only relative time; this for
  Linux-only process introspection). The common cause is the same each time: a
  check whose only consumer is a test that cannot run on this host.
- BL-41…
Approval context: One deliberate scope call to sign off or overturn, plus a new feature draft.
The call: this ticket fixes the PRODUCTION liveness probe (a real macOS facility behind the existing shared primitive), rather than marking the three tests skipped-on-macOS. Skipping is cheaper and is defensible on the arg…
BL-877 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-877" (or "reject BL-877 <reason>") to act.
